name: What the Annex notice means
subject: interpretation
question: meaning
brief: A notice at the NGA Ward Annex says that supervised training is available to residents who have completed the school safety course, and that applications are considered in order of ward residence. Your group must say what the notice means. You are the recorder, taking the group's notes. The notice board and a counter leaflet are all the Annex puts out, so every further source costs the group a trip to ask.

claims.name: Training is open to any student who has completed the safety course
Training is open in principle, but ward residents are served first
Supervised training means combat classes for schoolchildren

evidence.name: The notice says 'residents who have completed the school safety course'
The leaflet on the counter lists first aid, evacuation drill and equipment checks
The notice says applications are 'considered in order of ward residence'
Amit Roy told Tara Das the Annex had twelve places this term
The notice carries the Annex's date stamp from March

limitations.name: This is one notice, read without the Annex's own rules
Twelve places is a figure from one conversation and may change
The notice does not say whether applicants are judged on more than residence

note: The NGA Ward Annex, Amit Roy and Tara Das are from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md (loc_authority_annex, npc_amit_roy, npc_tara_das); the notice is invented. The Gate safety procedure is fictional (INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md, School bible).
